description.value: Become permanently immune to fire and gain strong resistance to radiation. The Choir of Ash treats you as a living relic.

cinderfall.incomplete: 'Gain strong resistance to radiation' states no formula or number -- 'strong' isn't a value, and reusing the standard max(1,floor(@actor.level/2)) tier would contradict the card's own claim that this is stronger than Banked Warmth's baseline. The fire immunity half is built above.
